Bangkok is one of the world's premier destinations for bespoke tailoring, offering quality craftsmanship at prices significantly lower than London, New York, or Milan. The city contains hundreds of tailors ranging from budget operations targeting tourists to luxury establishments serving diplomats and business executives. The best Bangkok tailors combine traditional handcraftsmanship with modern styling to produce custom suits, shirts, and dresses that fit precisely and last for years.

Best Tailors in Bangkok

1. Rajawongse Clothier

Location: Sukhumvit Soi 4 (Nana)

Specialty: Business suits, shirts, basic alterations

Suit Price: $180-$280

Shirt Price: $35-$50

Turnaround: 3-4 days

Budget Category ($150-$300 Suits)

Rajawongse has served Bangkok for over 40 years, building a reputation for consistent quality at reasonable prices. They work quickly and handle the basics well. Best for travelers who need a straightforward business suit without complications.

Why choose them: Fast turnaround, reliable quality, no-pressure sales approach

2. Narin Tailor

Location: Sukhumvit Soi 8

Specialty: Business casual, shirts, alterations

Suit Price: $150-$250

Shirt Price: $30-$45

Turnaround: 2-3 days

Budget Category ($150-$300 Suits)

Narin offers some of the best prices on Sukhumvit Road without the aggressive sales tactics common in the area. They focus on practical business wear rather than fashion-forward styling.

Why choose them: Honest pricing, quick service, good for basic wardrobe building

3. Crown Tailor

Location: Silom Road

Specialty: Corporate wear, uniform contracts

Suit Price: $200-$300

Shirt Price: $40-$55

Turnaround: 3-5 days

Budget Category ($150-$300 Suits)

Crown Tailor has served Bangkok's business district for decades. They handle large corporate orders but welcome individual clients. Their location away from tourist areas means lower pressure and often better prices.

Why choose them: Business district location, corporate experience, consistent results

Mid-Range Category ($300-$600 Suits)

These tailors balance quality and price, offering better fabrics and more attention to fit than budget options without luxury pricing.

4. Jesse & Son

Location: Sukhumvit Soi 10

Specialty: Bespoke suits, shirts, women's tailoring

Suit Price: $400-$650

Shirt Price: $60-$90

Turnaround: 5-7 days

Mid-Range Category ($300-$600 Suits)

Jesse & Son has built a reputation for personalized service and consistent quality. They pay particular attention to fit and offer genuine bespoke service with multiple fittings. Their women's tailoring is notably better than most Bangkok tailors.

Why choose them: Excellent fit, genuine bespoke process, strong women's offerings

5. Tailor on Ten

Location: Sukhumvit Soi 8

Specialty: Classic British styling, wedding suits

Suit Price: $450-$750

Shirt Price: $70-$100

Turnaround: 5-7 days

Mid-Range Category ($300-$600 Suits)

Tailor on Ten focuses on classic British cuts with structured shoulders and tapered waists. They source quality fabrics from reputable mills and offer proper canvased construction. Popular with expats and wedding parties.

Why choose them: Classic styling, quality construction, wedding expertise

6. Bespoke Tailor Bangkok

Location: Silom Complex

Specialty: Business suits, casual jackets

Suit Price: $350-$550

Shirt Price: $55-$80

Turnaround: 4-6 days

Mid-Range Category ($300-$600 Suits)

Bespoke Tailor Bangkok offers solid mid-range quality with a focus on practical business wear. Their location in Silom Complex makes them convenient for business district workers.

Why choose them: Business district location, good value, reliable quality

7. Cavalry Lane

Location: Sukhumvit Soi 23

Specialty: Contemporary styling, slim fits

Suit Price: $400-$600

Shirt Price: $60-$85

Turnaround: 5-7 days

Mid-Range Category ($300-$600 Suits)

Cavalry Lane targets younger professionals with modern, slim-fitting cuts. They understand contemporary styling better than traditional tailors while maintaining quality construction.

Why choose them: Modern styling, younger demographic, good fit for slim builds

8. Peninsula Tailors

Location: Peninsula Plaza (adjacent to Peninsula Hotel)

Specialty: Luxury bespoke, formal wear

Suit Price: $800-$1,500

Shirt Price: $100-$180

Turnaround: 7-10 days

High-End Category ($600-$1,200 Suits)

Peninsula Tailors has dressed diplomats, business leaders, and celebrities for decades. Their Peninsula Plaza location reflects their positioning. Expect extensive fabric choices from top European mills and meticulous handwork.

Why choose them: Top-tier fabrics, exceptional craftsmanship, prestigious clientele

9. Embassy Tailors

Location: Wireless Road (near US Embassy)

Specialty: Diplomatic clientele, formal wear

Suit Price: $700-$1,300

Shirt Price: $90-$160

Turnaround: 7-10 days

High-End Category ($600-$1,200 Suits)

True to their name, Embassy Tailors has served diplomatic staff and international business executives for years. Their location near the US Embassy makes them convenient for embassy workers and visiting dignitaries.

Why choose them: Diplomatic experience, discreet service, consistent quality

10. Suit Cut Bespoke

Location: Thong Lor Soi 13

Specialty: Modern bespoke, fashion-forward styling

Suit Price: $650-$1,100

Shirt Price: $80-$140

Turnaround: 7-10 days

High-End Category ($600-$1,200 Suits)

Suit Cut Bespoke bridges traditional craftsmanship with contemporary style. They understand current fashion while maintaining proper tailoring techniques. Popular with creative professionals and fashion-conscious executives.

Why choose them: Fashion-forward approach, quality construction, younger clientele

11. Narry Bespoke

Location: Silom Road

Specialty: Traditional British tailoring

Suit Price: $750-$1,300

Shirt Price: $95-$170

Turnaround: 7-10 days

High-End Category ($600-$1,200 Suits)

Narry focuses on traditional British tailoring with structured shoulders, roped sleeveheads, and classic proportions. They source fabrics from British mills including Holland & Sherry and Dormeuil.

Why choose them: Authentic British styling, premium fabrics, traditional techniques

12. Tom's Fashion

Location: Sukhumvit Soi 8

Specialty: Ultra-luxury bespoke, VIP service

Suit Price: $1,500-$3,000+

Shirt Price: $180-$350

Turnaround: 10-14 days

High-End Category ($600-$1,200 Suits)

Tom's Fashion caters to clients who want the best regardless of price. They offer fully handmade construction, personal consultations, and the finest fabrics available including Loro Piana, Zegna, and Scabal.

Why choose them: Ultimate luxury, fully handmade, VIP treatment

13. Pinky Tailor

Location: Mahatun Plaza

Specialty: High-end bespoke, Hollywood clientele

Suit Price: $1,200-$2,500

Shirt Price: $150-$300

Turnaround: 7-10 days

High-End Category ($600-$1,200 Suits)

Pinky Tailor has dressed Hollywood stars, politicians, and business moguls. Their reputation attracts clients who demand the best. Expect extensive fittings and meticulous attention to every detail.

Why choose them: Celebrity clientele, meticulous construction, prestigious reputation

14. Universal Tailors

Location: Silom Complex

Specialty: Executive tailoring, luxury corporate wear

Suit Price: $1,000-$2,000

Shirt Price: $120-$250

Turnaround: 7-10 days

High-End Category ($600-$1,200 Suits)

Universal Tailors has served Bangkok's C-suite executives for decades. They understand the specific needs of senior business leaders who need impeccable presentation.

Why choose them: Executive expertise, boardroom-ready results, discretion

15. Attire House

Location: Gaysorn Village (Chidlom)

Specialty: Contemporary luxury, fashion-forward bespoke

Suit Price: $1,200-$2,200

Shirt Price: $140-$280

Turnaround: 10-14 days

High-End Category ($600-$1,200 Suits)

Attire House occupies the luxury Gaysorn Village mall, reflecting their positioning. They combine traditional craftsmanship with contemporary design sensibility for clients who want luxury without stuffiness.

Why choose them: Luxury location, contemporary luxury positioning, fashion-forward approach

How Much Does a Tailored Suit Cost in Bangkok?

Bangkok tailoring prices vary dramatically based on fabric quality, construction method, and tailor reputation. Understanding the price ranges helps you set realistic expectations before visiting.

What Price Ranges Should You Expect?

Category Suit Price Range Shirt Price Range Typical Quality
Budget $150-$300 $30-$50 Machine construction, basic fabrics
Mid-Range $300-$600 $50-$80 Mixed hand/machine, decent fabrics
High-End $600-$1,200 $80-$150 Mostly handmade, premium fabrics
Luxury $1,200-$3,000+ $150-$300+ Fully handmade, top-tier fabrics

Budget tailors offer excellent value for travelers who need a decent suit quickly. Luxury tailors provide craftsmanship comparable to Savile Row at roughly half the price.

What Affects Tailoring Prices in Bangkok?

  • Fabric selection: Fabric accounts for 30-50% of total cost. Entry-level polyester blends cost significantly less than high-end wool from mills like Loro Piana or Zegna.
  • Construction method: Machine stitching costs less than hand stitching. Canvas construction costs more than fused construction. Fully handmade garments command premium prices.
  • Turnaround time: Rush orders typically cost 20-30% more. Standard turnaround is 3-5 days. Same-day or next-day service requires premium pricing.
  • Tailor location: Tailors in tourist-heavy areas like Sukhumvit Road often charge more than those in business districts. Location convenience carries a price premium.

How Long Does Tailoring Take in Bangkok?

Turnaround times vary by tailor and complexity. Understanding timelines helps you plan your trip.

What Are Standard Turnaround Times?

Garment Type Budget Tailors Mid-Range High-End Luxury
Single suit 2-3 days 3-5 days 5-7 days 7-14 days
Multiple suits 3-5 days 5-7 days 7-10 days 10-21 days
Shirts (each) 1-2 days 2-3 days 3-5 days 5-7 days
Alterations Same day 1-2 days 2-3 days 3-5 days

Can You Get Same-Day or Next-Day Service?

Some tailors offer rush service for an additional 20-30% surcharge. Same-day service is possible for simple alterations or single items. Complete suits require at least 24-48 hours even with rush fees.

Rush orders compromise the fitting process. Expect fewer fittings and less precise results.

How Many Fittings Should You Expect?

  • Budget tailors: Usually 1-2 fittings maximum
  • Mid-range: 2-3 fittings
  • High-end: 3-4 fittings
  • Luxury: 4+ fittings including basted fittings

Multiple fittings produce better results. Each fitting refines the fit based on how the garment settles on your body.

FAQ: Getting Suits Tailored in Bangkok

How much should I budget for a tailored suit in Bangkok?

Budget $150-$300 for entry-level suits, $300-$600 for good quality, $600-$1,200 for high-end, and $1,200+ for luxury bespoke.

How long does tailoring take in Bangkok?

Budget tailors complete suits in 2-3 days. Mid-range requires 3-5 days. High-end and luxury tailors need 7-14 days for proper construction and multiple fittings.

Is Bangkok tailoring good quality?

Yes. The best Bangkok tailors produce quality comparable to Hong Kong or Singapore at lower prices. Quality varies significantly by tailor tier.

Can women get tailored clothing in Bangkok?

Yes, though fewer tailors specialize in women's tailoring. Jesse & Son and Tailor on Ten have strong women's offerings.

What fabric should I choose for a Bangkok suit?

For Bangkok's climate, choose lightweight wool (9-11 oz) or wool-silk-linen blends. Avoid heavy fabrics meant for European winters.

How do I avoid tourist trap tailors?

Avoid tailors with aggressive street touts. Research reviews before visiting. Quality tailors do not need to chase customers.

Should I bring a suit to copy?

Yes. Bringing a well-fitting garment as a template helps tailors understand your preferred fit.

What payment methods do Bangkok tailors accept?

Most accept cash and credit cards. Luxury tailors may accept wire transfers. Budget tailors prefer cash.

Can tailors ship finished garments internationally?

Yes. Most established tailors offer international shipping. Factor in shipping time and customs duties.

What if my suit needs alterations after I return home?

Established tailors stand behind their work. Contact them about issues. Some offer credit toward future purchases if local alterations are needed.

Is it cheaper to buy fabric separately?

Generally no. Tailors get wholesale fabric prices. Retail fabric purchases often cost more than tailors charge for fabric included in suit pricing.

How do I know if a tailor is reputable?

Check online reviews, ask for referrals, look at their existing work, and trust your instincts about sales pressure.
